title: Sukha Singh Kills the Pathan and the Khalsa Charges

blocks.text: The duel turns savage as shield, sword, and horse all begin to fail under repeated blows. What began as formal combat collapses into a close struggle on the ground, showing how evenly matched and determined both fighters are.

At the decisive moment, Sukha Singh seizes a fallen knife and kills the Pathan. The victory preserves Khalsa honor precisely because it is won after endurance, improvisation, and refusal to yield when the contest becomes desperate.

The single combat immediately widens into collective battle. The Khalsa charges once Sukha Singh prevails, and Charat Singh moves through the mêlée to recover his companion as the enemy line begins to break.
